channel.desc: All the buyers are excited about the upscale potential of Rancho Palos Verdes, but it's Dave who finds his loot there; Brandi racks up a decent profit while saving herself from having to shell out for shelving; in Garden Grove, Kerri keeps Lisa focused long enough to weave a profit, while Kenny faces his fears in a new way.
